tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists every category of Systra Tools with the number of components in it.

tools.name: list_components
tools.description: Lists components of the library. Optionally filtered by category slug ('heros', 'forms', 'cta').

tools.name: search_components
tools.description: Searches components by a keyword in the name or the category and returns the matches.

tools.name: get_component
tools.description: Returns the complete, copy-ready React/TSX source of a component by its name.

tools.name: list_styles
tools.description: Lists the brand styles extracted with the style extractor (colours and fonts of real websites) that can be applied to components.

tools.name: get_style
tools.description: Returns every design token of an extracted brand style: colours, typography, CSS variables and the generated DESIGN.md.

tools.name: get_component_styled
tools.description: Returns a component together with the design tokens of a brand style and precise instructions for adapting it, so the component lands directly in your own brand look.

tools.name: list_images
tools.description: Lists the images of the Systra Tools media library (all AI-generated) with ready, permanently valid URLs to drop straight in. Optionally filtered by album and format, 100 per page.

tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Searches the media library (all images AI-generated) by keywords in the title, the tags, the file name or the album and returns ready URLs, 100 per page.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Lists the Instagram post templates of Systra Tools (1080 x 1350). Every template is a single HTML file that can be rebuilt and exported as an image or a video.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Returns a post template as a complete set of working instructions: the HTML file, the export script and the rules on what may be changed. With it the post can be rebuilt and rendered directly.

tools.name: list_recipes
tools.description: Lists curated page recipes: sensible sequences of sections for complete landing pages (SaaS, coaching, hotel and so on).

tools.name: get_recipe
tools.description: Returns a page recipe: the sequence of sections with the purpose of each one and the complete source of every section. Optionally in the look of a brand style.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_images, search_images, list_posts, get_post · Private data: get_style, get_component_styled, search_images, list_posts, get_post · Public sink: list_posts, get_post · Destructive: list_images.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_images, search_images, list_posts, get_post · Private data: get_style, get_component_styled, search_images, list_posts, get_post · Public sink: list_posts, get_post · Destructive: list_images

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_categories" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Listet alle Kategorien von Systra Tools mit der Anzahl der enthaltenen Komponenten." → after: "Lists every category of Systra Tools with the number of components in it."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
